Itemized Passive Description:
*Basic effect(s)*
- Launches an additional Super Attack
- "Crossover" or "Time Travelers" Category allies' Ki +2 and
ATK & DEF 30%{passiveImg:up_g}
*Per "Crossover" or "Time Travelers" Category ally on the team
(depending on which Category has more members)*
- ATK & DEF 100%{passiveImg:up_g} (up to 500%)
- Chance of performing a critical hit & damage reduction rate 10%{passiveImg:up_g}
(up to 50%)
*When attacking with 12 or more Ki*
- ATK 250%{passiveImg:up_g}
*When receiving an attack with 12 or more Ki*
- DEF 250%{passiveImg:up_g}
*For 4 turns from the character's entry turn*
- Ki +4 and DEF 250%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Foresees enemy's Super Attack within the character's attacking turn
*When attacking as the 2nd attacker in a turn*
- ATK 100%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Launches an additional attack that has a great chance of becoming
a Super Attack
*When attacking as the 3rd attacker in a turn*
- Launches 2 additional attacks, each of which has a great chance of
becoming a Super Attack
*For every attack performed*
- {passiveImg:forever}Ki +1
